item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=quantifying+epistemic+value+of+information+and+return+on+investment+in+research+projects&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.5220/0009416200430052\", \"title\": [\"Return on Cybersecurity Investment in Operational Technology Systems: Quantifying the Value That Cybersecurity Technologies Provide after Integration\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.5220/0009416200430052\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2020]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.4324/9780429429415-8\", \"title\": [\"Return on Investment Analysis: Building a Financial Model\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4324/9780429429415-8\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2019, 1, 18]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.4324/9780429429415-7\", \"title\": [\"Managing Healthcare Information Technology as an Investment: The Value-Management Plan\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.4324/9780429429415-7\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2019, 1, 18]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.62915/2472-2707.1297\", \"title\": [\"A Return on Investment (ROI) Evaluation Tool for Quantifying the Value of Cybersecurity Certifications\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>The growing reliance on cybersecurity certifications has increased the financial and professional stakes associated with certification decision-making for cybersecurity professionals. Despite their widespread use in hiring and career advancement, there is limited objective guidance available to help individuals evaluate the return on investment (ROI) of specific certifications. This gap has created uncertainty regarding which credentials provide the greatest value relative to their cost and market impact. This study presents a data-driven, design science–based tool that supports cybersecurity professionals in evaluating certification ROI using practitioner survey data combined with certification cost and labor-market demand indicators. The paper also demonstrates how such a tool can improve transparency and support more informed, evidence-based certification planning within cybersecurity education and workforce development contexts.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.62915/2472-2707.1297\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026, 8, 19]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "ad789d9a74068ad1435d84eb916e93d97…
